newsitem.title: USA: Unify sees Q2 net loss of $0.22/share.
newsitem.headline: Unify sees Q2 net loss of $0.22/share.

text.p: Unify Corp warned on Tuesday that it is lowering its estimated results for the upcoming quarter, and now expects to report a net loss of approximately $0.22 a share in the second fiscal quarter ended October 31 on lower-than-expeccted revenues.

Based on preliminary results, the company expects to incur a pretax loss for the second fiscal quarter of approximately $1.8 million, the company said in a statement. It said it does not expect to record any tax benefit on this loss, thus the prediction for a net loss of $0.22 per share.

According to First Call, the San Jose, Calif.-based provider of client/server technology was expected to report a profit of $0.01 a share. Year-ago comparisons were not available because the company went public in June.
Unify said second quarter results will be released after the market closes on November 18.
The company said second quarter revenues are estimated to be approximately $7.2 million.

"Revenue from our traditional lines of business was largely in line with expectations. However, we are seeing longer sales cycles and larger potential transaction sizes which adversely impacted our graphical product results this quarter. These factors make it difficult for us to predict the timing of these deals," said Chief Executive Officer Reza Mikailli.
Separately, Unify said James Fleming, vice president, worldwide sales, is no longer with the company. Until a successor is named, Reza Mikailli will assume his duties.
